p.i: ra Midian, seditq; iuxta puteum. Erant autem sacerdotis Midian septem filiae, quae venerunt & hauserunt, impleveruntq; canales, ut potarent oves patris sui. Et venerunt pastores atque repulerunt eas: & confurgens Moses, auxiliatus est eis, potauitq; oves illarum. Quae venientes ad Rehuel patrem suum, dixit ille: Quare hodie tam festinanter redijstis? Responderunt: Vir Aegyptius liberavit nos de manu pastorum, nam hauriendo hausit nobis, atque potum praebuit ovibus. Qui dixit ad filias suas, & ubi est ille? quare sic dereliquistis virum illum? vocate eum, ut comedat panem. Et conscensit Moses habitare cum viro illo: dedit{que} ille Ziporam filiam suam Mosi. Quae cum peperisset filium, vocavit ille nomen eius Gerson. dixit enim: peregrinus fui in terra aliena.

main_text.p: Trium personarum potissimè fit mentio in his verbis: nimirum Mosis, Rehuelis, Ziporae: hoc est, generi, soceri, uxoris.

page.notes: Running head and page number are read at small size; "118" is the most likely reading. The catchword is read as "sionem" from a worn letter, so it is doubtful. The italic passage has no clear paragraph indents, so it is kept as one paragraph. The opening of the numbered paragraph is in heavier type, which the markup does not show. The printed "Gerson" is spelled as in the print, with "Gersom" not used. Long s is rendered as s throughout.
